clue.text: Mild rebuke just what's needed in turn for every player

parts.note: tut is the little click of disapproval, a mild telling-off

parts.note: 'it' is slang for exactly the thing required, as in 'that's it!'

explanation.walkthrough: 'in turn' is the reversal sign; 'just what's needed' is slang for the very thing, as in 'that's it!'. Tutti is the Italian musical direction.
explanation.definitionFit: A musical direction meaning all performers play together, so it is marked for the entire ensemble.

clue.text: Silly cuts render film upsetting?

clue.text: Sort of cross and tense when bottom's pinched

clue.text: Home and dry, with time for cricket?

clue.text: Engage security system with alarms

clue.text: Foul lake made unusual compost

clue.text: It's believed no fighter would box in his corner?

clue.text: Listened to one putting up with joint stiffness

clue.text: Pole joining with another in item promoting Polish

clue.text: Pointless employment website — for brief time one brings no relief!

clue.text: Birthday celebrations, with decorations not up, got going
